claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-generated submission-evidence artefact that moves toward a consequential action (Quality-Unit approval, reliance in a dossier, lot release, Health-Authority submission) MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision — the agent, the evidence artefact, the intended consequential action, and the named Qualified Person / Quality Unit head under whose authority it proceeds. Artefacts lacking a recorded authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Before an AI-generated submission-evidence artefact proceeds to a consequential action it MUST carry a recorded due-diligence result — competence (ICH Q10), a decision / validation / justification basis (ICH Q9 / Q8), and a data-integrity / ALCOA+ screen (ICH Q7) where applicable. An unscreened, low-confidence, or data-integrity-deficient artefact is refused.

Every AI-generated submission-evidence artefact that proceeds toward a consequential action MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable provenance pin binding the generating model and version, the inputs and pinned source data, the decision / validation / justification basis applied, the due-diligence result relied on, and the named-authority outcome — audit-grade, ICH Q7 data-integrity-aligned provenance verifiable offline, reconstructable and valid at T=0.

An AI-generated submission-evidence artefact MUST remain advisory and MUST NOT drive a consequential action until a named human reviewer — the Qualified Person, the Quality Unit head, or a responsible QA officer — records sign-off. The irreversible lot release / regulatory dossier submission additionally requires §36 two-person sign-off (the preparing quality reviewer AND an approving Qualified Person / Quality Unit head). Unreviewed AI-driven consequential actions are refused and routed dual-channel.

ICH tells you WHAT evidence regulators require; KYE proves HOW that evidence came into existence — who approved it, under what authority, valid at T=0, lawful delegation, replay-provable. KYE does not perform the science, run the stability study, set impurity thresholds, validate the analytical method, run the quality engine, or judge whether the quality is acceptable.
